description: Translate a draft or scheduled push campaign's title and message with AI into the workspace's languages and save the versions. Contacts then get the version for their language attribute or device language. Versions a person wrote are kept unless overwrite is true. Returns the campaign plus translated, skipped and failed languages.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

locales.description: Languages to translate into (codes from the workspace's language list). Omit for every language except the main one.

overwrite.description: Retranslate every requested language, replacing versions a person wrote. By default only languages with no version and outdated AI versions are translated.

name: translate_push_campaign

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `translate_push_campaign` MCP tool.

campaign.description: The push campaign record returned by Sequenzy.

failed.description: Languages that could not be translated: {locale, error}.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

skipped.description: Languages left as they were: {locale, reason} with reason up_to_date or edited (written by a person).
